proposal.reason: Main change is CI workflow execution policy: .github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml adds authenticated registry login before pulls, resolves t-head/pccl-tests by matching branch with fallback, and introduces artifact_version time-based commit pinning (plus paired pccl-tests pinning) that changes what commit each run builds. .github/workflows/source-sanity.yml and pccl-daily-full.yml propagate the same resolved pccl-tests revision/branch through checkout, cache probe/publish, and runner-revision assertions. .github/xtest/artifact_cache.py and test_workflow_contract.py only align fixture-label constants with that CI contract, so they remain supporting edits under ci rather than a separate module.
